description: The line plot illustrates the relative change in performance across different layers of the Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct model when applying layer-wise quantized pruning using the SnapKV method, with a KV cache budget of 1/64. The x-axis represents five distinct layer ranges: Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, and Layer29-32, each corresponding to a segment of the model's layers. The y-axis measures the relative change in performance, ranging from -25% to +5%, with a horizontal dashed line at 0% indicating the baseline performance. Five distinct methods are compared: "LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit" (yellow line with circular markers), "LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit" (red line with square markers), "RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit" (light blue line with circular markers), "RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit" (dark blue line with square markers), and "Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit" (grey dashed line). The "LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit" method shows a relatively stable performance, starting near 0% and slightly increasing to just above 0% across the layers. The "LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit" method starts slightly above 0%, dips to approximately -4% at Layer13-20, and then recovers to around -1% at Layer29-32. The "RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit" method begins at approximately -2%, drops significantly to -12% at Layer13-20, and then sharply recovers to just below 0% at Layer29-32. The "RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit" method starts at about -5%, plummets to -25% at Layer13-20, and then climbs back to approximately -3% at Layer29-32. The "Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit" method remains constant at 0% across all layers, serving as the reference point.
